name: Ephemeris Propagator
description: Propagates a spacecraft from an ephemeris CONTAINER rather than from elements: SPK (NAIF DAF, segment types 8, 9 and 13), Code-500, STK ephemeris and CCSDS-OEM, behind one format discriminator. It answers the same plugin_propagate / plugin_propagate_batch as the element-based providers, so a consumer drives it with no branch of its own — the pluggable-propagation law applied to the one family that most invites a bypass, because a file already contains the answer and reading it in the consumer is how a JavaScript propagator gets built. Ingest is plugin_init_ephemeris(bytes, len, format), not plugin_init: the generic init verb is bound by the ABI to packed OrbProOMMRecord data and must refuse any length that is not a whole multiple of that struct, so this module exports no plugin_init at all rather than exporting a lie. Each container is evaluated by the interpolation rule the container itself declares — an SPK segment type fixes it, an OEM and an STK file say it outright — never by a rule this module picked. States exit in the container's own declared frame with StateVector.reference_frame set to say which, translated by named token onto the ABI roster; a declared frame with no roster member is a refusal, because a guessed frame is wrong by up to a full Earth rotation. Positions and velocities exit in ABI-normative metres. Pure compute — no capabilities, no host calls, no filesystem.
tagline: Propagates from an SPK, Code-500, STK or CCSDS-OEM container behind the standard propagator port.

sequentialJustification.detail: Ingest is a single pass over one container buffer and every propagate call is a bounded interpolation over an already-resident window. The module spawns nothing, shares nothing across calls beyond the loaded series, and has no work to fan out: a caller wanting parallelism batches entities, which is caller-level and already expressed by plugin_propagate_batch.

inputPorts.description: SDS $OEM envelope describing the trajectory to summarise. The propagation entry point for a native container is the plugin_init_ephemeris ABI export, which carries raw container bytes and therefore has no SDS port identity to declare; this method is the record-shaped surface for the same series.

outputPorts.description: SDS $OEM envelope carrying the series as this module resolved it: declared frame, centre, time system, interpolation rule and degree, and the state rows.
